description.label: Description
description.value: You have mastered the art of bringing down foes non-lethally. Whenever you deal a Critical Hit to an opponent, you may instead make an Average (+20) Intelligence Test. If you succeed, you inflict +1 Fatigued Condition upon your target for each SL you scored on the Intelligence Test. Further, you gain a +40 bonus to any Heal Test to treat the wounds of your target once they’ve been subdued, assuming they’re still alive.

tests.label: Tests
tests.value: Melee tests when trying to bring down a foe non-lethally
